response.sql:
WITH matched_transactions AS (
  SELECT tr.tradekind
  FROM transactionrecord AS tx
  JOIN trader AS tr
    ON tx.trdref = tr.tradereg
), per_type AS (
  SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS type_count
  FROM matched_transactions
  GROUP BY tradekind
), stats AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    type_count,
    SUM(type_count) OVER () AS total_count,
    AVG(type_count::numeric) OVER () AS average_count
  FROM per_type
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  type_count,
  type_count::numeric / total_count AS share_of_total,
  type_count::numeric - average_count AS above_average_by
FROM stats
WHERE type_count > average_count
ORDER BY tradekind NULLS FIRST;

assumptions.assumption: “How big is each trader type in this data?” counts matched transaction records, as specified, rather than distinct trader accounts.
